findings.quote: One is rapidly advancing toward the fourth industrial revolution and artificial intelligence, while the other remains hostage to poverty and marginalization.
findings.rationale: Describes a widening divide between countries advancing in AI and those excluded by poverty and marginalization.

findings.quote: It requires us to unite our efforts to devise solutions that are capable of narrowing this gap by achieving just and comprehensive human-centered development and the right of every human to a dignified life.
findings.rationale: Direct continuation of the preceding AI-linked developmental divide, calling for collective action to narrow it through equitable human-centered development.
